unit_convention: All engine prices are index_2026Q1_100. External USD quotes are optional observed anchors and never imply a GCU/USD parity.

price_anchor_ingestion_rule.published_or_coverage: World Bank Pink Sheet monthly XLS, latest referenced July 2026; historical 1960–latest
price_anchor_ingestion_rule.method: On scenario publication, snapshot the specified source series/date/unit; set engine price index=100 at that snapshot; store raw quote, raw unit, download URL, retrieval date and checksum in the scenario snapshot.
price_anchor_ingestion_rule.why_placeholder: No stale or unverified raw USD quote is copied into this version-controlled starter package.

source.conversion: raw monthly USD quote / scenario anchor quote * 100

clearing.allocation: pro_rata after priority contracts; rationing is explicit when physical supply < committed demand

no price update may use an empty denominator

trade_and_logistics.why_placeholder: A fictional bilateral matrix must be deliberately designed, not copied from a real trade network.
trade_and_logistics.generation_rule: Gravity-style seed: w_ij proportional to exporter_capacity_i * importer_demand_j * exp(-0.04*route_time_days_ij) * policy_access_ij, then IPF-balance rows/columns to world totals.
trade_and_logistics.key_strait_rule: Use fictional route-node IDs only. A closure reduces available route capacity and raises insurance; it does not alter geographic distance or create goods.

project_template.milestone_rule: No capacity/productivity benefit before commissioning. Capital is accumulated by verified milestones net of leakage; delays shift milestones and may raise financing cost.

contract_template.settlement: expected_credit_loss = exposure_after_deposit * default_probability * loss_given_default; payment and delivery are separate state machines.
contract_template.force_majeure: Requires a named eligible event, evidence timestamp, mitigation effort and a defined cure/termination window; no generic automatic escape clause.
